brief.title: Rank candidate chunks with BM25 and dense cosine Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60)
brief.plain_summary: Score candidate chunks lexically with Okapi BM25 and semantically with cosine similarity, then fuse both ranked lists via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60).
brief.outcome: Deterministic RRF-ranked candidate chunk list with lexical and dense rank diagnostics.

brief.title: Pack sanitized chunks into a strict token budget via redundancy-penalized 0/1 knapsack
brief.plain_summary: Discount marginal overlap against higher-ranked chunks and solve exact 0/1 dynamic-programming knapsack to maximize context utility within token_budget.
brief.outcome: A conforming packed-context receipt listing selected_ids, total_tokens and total_adjusted_utility.
